Drew Brees had a chance to stand with his Black teammates and the entire Black community. Instead he gave an answer in an interview that undermines what Kaepernick knelt for and what BLM stands for. He gave into false rhetoric about what taking a knee is about. Shame on him!

Black people have served in many if not all American wars. When they came back after those wars, they were not seen as equals. Despite their service and sacrifice for our country. That is both sad and disgusting. Kneeling was never and is never about the flag.

It's about ensuring police brutality is ended. It's saying "I do not stand for the abrupt end Black lives have seen due to police brutality and racism." It's about ensuring Black lives are respected. That is what taking a knee is about. Not a flag nor disrespecting the military.
